errors.quote: it computes the [Discrete Fourier transform](dft.md) of an array in $\log_2 t$ layers instead of $t^2$ operations
errors.problem: Compares a count of layers with a count of operations. The direct sum costs about t^2 operations, and the layered procedure costs O(t log t) operations (t/2 butterflies and t/2 twiddles in each of log_2 t layers), as the page itself says later. Paper (lines 88-91, 2877) counts log_2 t levels, each scanning the whole array.
